title: Mastering HR
subtitle: From Basics to Strategic Partnership
shortDescription: A complete HR Generalist programme, from core functions to strategic business partnering.
description: A complete HR Generalist training module covering core HR functions, Indian labour-law compliance, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, HR analytics, and the soft skills that turn an HR practitioner into a business partner. HR has moved from an administrative back-office function to a seat at the business table, and this programme takes a learner from first principles all the way to strategic HR practice.
goal: To equip participants with a comprehensive understanding of core HR functions, legal compliance, best practices and the skills necessary to perform effectively as an HR Generalist.
prerequisites: No prior HR experience required for the foundation parts.
outcomes: Understand the strategic role of HR within an organisation
Navigate key Indian labour laws and ensure compliance
Execute effective recruitment and selection processes
Develop and implement robust onboarding programmes
Manage employee relations, grievances and disciplinary action
Run performance management cycles using best practice
Administer compensation and benefits programmes
Apply the basics of HR analytics and reporting
Identify and mitigate common HR risks
Demonstrate core HR soft skills — communication, empathy, problem-solving
audience: Aspiring HR professionals entering the field and building a foundation from scratch
New HR Generalists in the role and needing end-to-end process confidence
Experienced HR practitioners refreshing skills and updating on current compliance
People managers seeking a deeper working understanding of HR functions

modules.title: The Strategic Role of HR & Foundational Concepts
modules.summary: Introduction to HR and its evolution from administrative function to business partner; HR structures and models; key HR metrics; ethics; organisational structure and culture; aligning HR with business goals and stakeholder management.

modules.title: HR Compliance & Legal Framework (India specific)
modules.summary: Factories Act; Industrial Disputes Act; Trade Unions Act; Contract Labour Act; Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages and Bonus Acts; EPF & ESI; POSH Act 2013; Maternity Benefit Act; Gratuity; Apprentices Act; the new Labour Codes and legal record-keeping.

modules.title: Talent Acquisition & Onboarding
modules.summary: Workforce planning and job analysis; sourcing, ATS, resume screening, structured and behavioural interviewing, assessment centres and offer management; designing pre-boarding through the first 90 days.

modules.title: Employee Relations & Engagement
modules.summary: Fair treatment and conflict resolution; grievance handling; disciplinary processes and their legal aspects; engagement, internal communication and feedback mechanisms; Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in practice.

modules.title: Performance Management & Development
modules.summary: SMART goals; appraisal methods including 360-degree, rating scales and BARS; feedback and performance improvement plans; training needs analysis, mentoring, career pathing and measuring L&D return.

modules.title: Compensation & Benefits
modules.summary: Compensation philosophy and strategy; job evaluation; pay structures and salary bands; CTC, in-hand pay and allowances; EPF, ESI, gratuity and bonus; non-statutory benefits and payroll basics including TDS.

modules.title: HR Operations, Technology & Analytics
modules.summary: HRIS modules across recruitment, payroll, performance and employee data; data security and privacy; HR metrics and dashboards; turnover and time-to-hire analysis; identifying and mitigating HR risk.

modules.title: Essential Soft Skills & Career Development
modules.summary: Active listening and empathetic communication; delivering difficult news; presentation and negotiation; case-study problem solving and ethical dilemmas; future trends and the HR Generalist career path.

delivery: Lectures and presentations — core concepts and frameworks, trainer-led
Case studies — real-world HR scenarios for problem solving
Practical exercises — draft a job description, calculate payroll components, build an onboarding checklist
Quizzes and assessments at the end of each section
Guest speakers — experienced HR professionals sharing field insight
Interactive simulations where the learning platform supports them
assessment: Module quizzes after each major part of the curriculum
Case study analysis — a detailed written analysis of a complex HR problem
Final project — develop an HR policy, create a recruitment plan, or design an engagement initiative
Final exam — multiple-choice and short-answer questions
Certificate of Completion awarded on successful completion of all assessments

title: Power BI
subtitle: From Raw Data to Business Insights
shortDescription: Clean data in Power Query, model it properly, write DAX, and publish decision-ready reports.
description: A hands-on Power BI training module that takes you from connecting and cleaning data in Power Query, through star-schema modelling and core DAX, to designing decision-ready reports and publishing and securing them in the Power BI Service. Data is only useful when people can act on it, so this module follows the full Power BI workflow — raw data to report to share — and learners finish able to build a complete, trustworthy reporting solution rather than a collection of isolated skills.
goal: By the end, learners can clean data in Power Query, build a sound star-schema model, write core DAX measures, design decision-ready reports, and publish and secure them in the Power BI Service.
prerequisites: Basic Excel (formulas, pivot tables). No coding needed. Power BI Desktop is free; a Pro or trial licence is needed for the sharing sessions.
outcomes: Connect to Excel, CSV, SQL, web and SharePoint, then clean and combine data in Power Query
Build a sound star schema with relationships, date tables and hierarchies
Write core DAX — measures, CALCULATE, time intelligence, variables and ranking
Choose the right visual and lay out a one-page storytelling report
Publish, schedule refresh and secure reports with row-level security
Deliver an end-to-end capstone solution and present it
audience: Analysts building reports and analysis for the business
MIS, finance, HR and operations professionals who report on their own function
Students building a job-ready data and reporting skill set
Managers who use dashboards and want to understand them

modules.title: Foundations
modules.summary: BI concepts and the Power BI ecosystem — Desktop vs Service vs Mobile; interface tour and a first report connecting to Excel or CSV. Activity: explore a sample report and list the business questions it answers.

modules.title: Getting and Cleaning Data (Power Query)
modules.summary: Connecting to Excel, CSV, folders, SQL, web and SharePoint; data types, split, replace, fill, pivot and unpivot; append vs merge, parameters and an introduction to M code. Activity: clean a deliberately messy sales file.

modules.title: Data Modelling
modules.summary: Star schema — fact and dimension tables and why flat files cause problems; cardinality, filter direction and inactive relationships; date tables and drill hierarchies. Activity: turn a flat file into a working star schema.

modules.title: DAX
modules.summary: Calculated columns vs measures; SUM, COUNT, DIVIDE and IF; filter context and CALCULATE; time intelligence for YTD, MTD and YoY; VAR, SUMX, RANKX and TOPN. Activity: build a KPI set for revenue, margin, growth and top products.

modules.title: Visualisation and Report Design
modules.summary: Choosing the right visual and when not to use pie charts; themes, colour, alignment and one-page layout; slicers, cross-filtering, drill-through, bookmarks and tooltips. Activity: redesign a cluttered report into a clean executive dashboard.

modules.title: Power BI Service and Governance
modules.summary: Workspaces, apps and permissions; scheduled refresh, gateways and row-level security; dashboards, pinned tiles, alerts, subscriptions, Q&A and the mobile view.

modules.title: Performance and Advanced Topics
modules.summary: Import vs DirectQuery, Performance Analyzer, reducing model size, incremental refresh, and an overview of Copilot features.

modules.title: Capstone
modules.summary: Each learner or team builds an end-to-end solution — data, model, DAX, report, published and secured — and presents it in ten minutes with feedback.

delivery: Practice on Microsoft's Contoso or Adventure Works sample data
Plus one real business file brought by each learner
Every part ends with a practical build
assessment: Part quizzes — a short quiz after each part
Capstone scored on data quality, model design, DAX accuracy, visual clarity and storytelling
Completion certificate, plus a bridge to the Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) exam

title: Microsoft Excel
subtitle: From Basics to Intermediate
shortDescription: Build confident, practical spreadsheet skills, one session at a time.
description: Microsoft Excel is the everyday tool of offices, finance teams, small businesses and classrooms. This online programme takes you from opening your first workbook to building formulas, tables, charts and a complete mini-project, in clear, practical steps with hands-on practice in every session.
goal: Take learners from their first workbook to a complete, presentable business workbook built from scratch.
prerequisites: A laptop or desktop with Microsoft Excel installed and a stable internet connection. No prior Excel experience required — if you can use a computer, you can start.
outcomes: Create, organise, save and share professional workbooks
Enter and format data quickly with AutoFill, Flash Fill and number formats
Turn raw lists into tables and answer questions with sort and filter
Build formulas and use functions such as SUM, IF, ROUND and lookups
Present results with clear charts, sparklines and conditional formatting
Complete a real, end-to-end mini-project in Excel
audience: Students and fresh graduates preparing for their first job
Office staff, admin, HR, finance and operations professionals
Small business owners tracking sales, stock and expenses
Anyone who has used Excel casually and wants proper, structured skills

modules.title: Getting Started with Excel
modules.summary: Understand what a workbook is, open and create files, and save your work safely.

modules.title: The Ribbon and Navigation
modules.summary: Find every tool quickly by understanding the Ribbon, formula bar, Name Box and navigation shortcuts.

modules.title: Managing Your Worksheets
modules.summary: Add, rename, reorder and delete sheet tabs, then organise and protect multi-sheet workbooks the way professionals do.

modules.title: Entering and Formatting Data
modules.summary: Enter, edit and fill data; column width, wrap text and cell styles; number formatting that makes worksheets easy to read.

modules.title: Organising Data with Tables, Sort and Filter
modules.summary: Turn plain ranges into Excel Tables and find answers by sorting and filtering.

modules.title: Calculations and Functions
modules.summary: AutoSum and Quick Analysis; formulas and cell references; the Function Library and Insert Function; logical and lookup functions.

modules.title: Charts and Visual Analysis
modules.summary: Build and customise your first chart, then add sparklines, conditional formatting and a PivotTable preview.

modules.title: Saving, Sharing and Capstone
modules.summary: Share and present your work with confidence, then apply everything in a final capstone project.

delivery: Learn by doing — every session includes at least two practical activities in Excel
Clear objectives — each session opens with what you will be able to do by the end
Quick check — a short understanding check closes every session
Real scenarios — budgets, sales lists, invoices and reports rather than abstract exercises
Capstone — finish by building and presenting your own business workbook
assessment: Session understanding checks throughout the programme
Capstone mini-project — build and present your own business workbook

title: Mastering MS Office
subtitle: From Computer Basics to Professional Productivity
shortDescription: One course. Every office skill you need — computer basics, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
description: From switching on a computer to presenting a polished business report, this course takes you step by step through computer fundamentals, Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Every session is hands-on, using real office files, so you learn by doing.
goal: Build complete, practical confidence across the everyday office toolkit, ending in a capstone project.
prerequisites: None. Designed for complete beginners, including career restarters. Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 required.
outcomes: Work confidently across Windows, files, internet, email and cloud storage
Format professional documents in Word with styles, tables, TOC and track changes
Run Mail Merge and export a polished resume to PDF
Use Excel formulas including IF, SUMIFS and XLOOKUP, plus charts and PivotTables
Design and deliver PowerPoint presentations using Slide Master, animation and media
Work across Office and OneDrive, and complete a capstone project

modules.title: Computer Fundamentals
modules.summary: Software, Windows and file management; internet, email and cloud storage; online safety and typing skills.

modules.title: Word: Foundations
modules.summary: Formatting, page layout, tables, pictures and shapes.

modules.title: Word: Professional
modules.summary: Styles, table of contents, track changes, Mail Merge and building a resume.

modules.title: Excel: Foundations
modules.summary: Data entry, formulas, sorting, filters and formatting.

modules.title: Excel: Intermediate
modules.summary: IF, lookups, charts, PivotTables and data validation.

modules.title: PowerPoint: Foundations
modules.summary: Layouts, visuals, charts and the Slide Master.

modules.title: PowerPoint: Presenting
modules.summary: Animation, media, storytelling and confident delivery.

modules.title: Integration and Capstone
modules.summary: Working across Office applications, OneDrive, and the final capstone project.

delivery: Hands-on every session, using real office files
Four applications covered in one structured programme
Practice files and shortcut cheat sheets provided
